news.t: Apply only on official websites — joinpakarmy.gov.pk, joinpaknavy.gov.pk, joinpaf.gov.pk
news.b: Selection is on merit. Anyone asking for money to get you selected is a fraud.

news.t: Next PMA Long Course (160): watch for the advert around March 2027
news.b: Long Course registration usually opens twice a year. 158 LC ran 24 Mar – 3 May 2026 and 159 LC ran 14 Sep – 23 Oct 2026. Use the months in between to train for the initial test and the 1.6 km run.

news.t: PAF officer induction usually opens in February and July
news.b: In 2026 registration ran 16 Feb – 1 Mar and 22 Jul – 3 Aug. Physics and maths carry real weight in the GD(P) academic test.

news.t: PN Cadet Term 2027-A: registration ran 13 Sep – 11 Oct 2026
news.b: The next Navy officer intake is usually advertised in spring. Engineering, Operations and Supply branches.

news.t: TCC and Lady Cadet Course adverts usually appear in December–January
news.b: Last cycle: 38th TCC closed 31 Jan 2026 and LCC-28 closed 20 Jan 2026. Keep your documents ready.

news.t: 159 PMA Long Course: registration closed 23 Oct 2026
news.b: If you registered, your initial test date is on your registration slip. Practise a full timed mock every few days.
